note: True totals add main, dedicated putter and explicitly quantified extra disc pockets. Use upper end of published ranges. Main+putter split is manual when sources publish only an aggregate total. Extra disc pockets are rendered with the main compartment in this shared artwork. Capacity varies with disc mix; never blocks saving.

models.note: Manufacturer catalog: Luxury E3, approximately 20 discs. Pocket counts are not specified reliably; enter your main/putter split instead of inventing it.

models.name: Latitude 64 E4
models.note: Maximum total 30 when all pockets hold discs; usual advertised load is approximately 20. Side putter pocket holds 2 and lid holds 2. The remaining 26 are pooled into main for this preset, not a verified main-compartment count; backup side-pocket capacity is unquantified.

models.name: Grip BX3
models.note: 18 main + 4 quick-pull putters + 1 top disc pocket. Pocket counts follow owner-confirmed fit rather than the advertised three-putter count.

models.name: Pound Octo

models.name: Upper Park Rebel
models.note: Working preset: 20 main + 6 putters across two top pockets. Owner reports span different versions; the advertised 30+ includes packed side/flap pockets, which this preset excludes.

models.name: Upper Park Shift
models.note: 20 packed discs is the upper reported range; about 16 fit comfortably. No dedicated putter pocket: capacity is pooled across three vertical envelopes and four side sleeves, represented as main slots.

models.name: MVP Voyager
